subject.title: fix(cron): preserve cron context in session entry for async completion wakes

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's durable cron marker, base-session fallback, and trusted synthetic model override as the intended fix for cron async media completion context loss?
rationale: The patch changes persisted session metadata and generated-media wake routing, so automation can verify mechanics but cannot own the upgrade and routing semantics decision.

options.title: Accept the narrow session-routing fix
options.body: Merge after maintainers accept the durable cron marker, base-session wake routing, and trusted synthetic override as the intended fix for the linked cron media context-loss bug.

options.title: Require stronger upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for one more exact-head proof or regression check showing existing non-cron sessions and old rows without bootstrapContextRunKind remain unchanged.

options.title: Pause for owner-designed continuation contract
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer a broader session-continuation contract instead of storing a cron marker on SessionEntry.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow session-routing fix
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainers accept the durable cron marker, base-session wake routing, and trusted synthetic override as the intended fix for the linked cron media context-loss bug.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest available routing owner from current-main blame and recent merged work on this completion handoff surface.
